reviews.Author: Norseman
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 15, 2023
reviews.Text: Ill be the forst to admit im a bit of a snob when it comes to salt. I dont even allow mortons or any iodized salts in ny kitchen. Much to my partners chagrin. I saw this product reviewed online and thought to give it a try. It has quickly become my everday salt for cooking. The texture is amazing and im able to pinch as much or as little as i need. Pair this with a nice salt well and your food need never be bland again. Great product.

reviews.Author: Gingersnap
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on January 15, 2023
reviews.Text: This flake-style sea salt is extra special. We actually are able to use LESS salt overall with flake-style salt because it lands on food and begins to dissolve immediately, spreading its salty taste over more surface area. The taste is really clean and pure, with zero additives or after-flavors! It's best to pour it from package dispenser spout into a salt box....then, pinch the quantity you need with fingertips and scatter over food... either during cooking, or while dining. Best salt we've ever found!
